description: On the green tabletop in front of you there’s a nested stack of bowls near the center-right, with a pillow in the background. The left hand reaches forward and grips the top small bowl while the right hand steadies the larger bowl beneath; the left hand lifts the small bowl up and slightly left to set it down, then the right hand lifts another bowl out and places it to the left so the bowls end up unstacked in a row, and both hands release and withdraw.
